job.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A genuinely hand-drawn colored-pencil and light watercolor UI sprite for a cozy animal-rescue storybook mobile game. Image 1 controls canvas size and object shape ONLY. Image 2 shows the actual game yard for palette and mood ONLY; do NOT draw scenery. Fine warm gray-green pencil contours with slight human wobble and occasional double pencil strokes, visible short colored-pencil hatching, light watercolor pigment pooling on matte ivory drawing paper. Soft spring mint, warm cream and pale peach colors; restrained, cute, clean and readable at phone size. Flat graphic, absolutely no glossy gradient, no digital airbrushed glow, no 3D, no plastic bevels, no drop shadow. PURE WHITE #ffffff outside the object, clear closed silhouette for alpha extraction. No words, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Draw ONE blank wide peach-cream button, centered, occupying 90% width and 68% height. Rounded oblong shape with softly imperfect pencil border in muted warm terracotta, thin and readable. Visible fine colored-pencil hatching across pale apricot watercolor wash, matte drawing paper feel. Slight human irregularity in edge. No glossy highlight, inner bevel, icons or extra decorations. Blank uniform center and symmetrical end caps.
job.negative: text, words, typography, numbers, watermark, screenshot, scenery, photorealistic, 3d, glossy, plastic, bevel, smooth digital gradient, airbrush, glowing outline, heavy black outline, dark brown frame, aged yellow parchment, distressed dirty paper, ripped edges, excessive ornaments, extra objects
